title: Evaluating and Modeling Attribution for Cross-Lingual Question Answering
reasoning: The paper directly addresses the "trustworthiness" of generative language models by proposing and evaluating attribution methods to combat "factual errors" and "harmful utterances." It discusses how these issues can make LLM deployments "harmful in the real world" and aims to improve the safety and reliability of NLP systems, which are core ethical considerations related to transparency, accountability, and user safety.
